[b][u]Summary of the Month - Saynala Informational Headliners, Augest 2028[/u][/b]

[b]The RSFA Act is Signed Into Law[/b]

President Achebe has recently signed the Rightful Seizure of Foreign Assets Act, better known as the RSFA act, in response to the financial sectors diminishing confidence in Lavia after the seizure of assets belonging to the states of Wuloosia and the Neue Republic. The seizures seemingly affected every citizen of the countries with investments in the ULR, however the bureaucratic process slowed these seizures enough to have affected much less than it was supposed to, and the recent signing has put the seizures fully on pause for those under suspicion, and assets held by those under no suspicion are in the process of being returned to their rightful owners. The government is also repaying those whose assets were already transferred to Rosenmarkke before the countrys collapse, pulling from the Excess Tax Emergency Fund. Both companies, investors, and government officials hope that this further action to right the wrongs of the seizures will help goodwill and confidence return to the symbol of investment stability that Lavia strives to be.

[b]Yumar Island Aviation EXI-71 Prototype Found After 66 Years[/b]

The YIA EXI-71, or the Experimental High Speed Interceptor and Pursuit Prototype, has long been the infatuation of aviation admirers. The massive jet was imagined in 1956, after an airforce contract was sent out for a high-performance, long-range interceptor. YIAs along with Huxleys proposals were picked to compete for the contract, and YIA immediately began work on producing its prototype. The jet would face multiple challenges, however on April 1st, 1959, the immense 39-ton aircraft would complete its first test flight. The prototype would fly for three more years, with an additional two prototypes being made to test separate weapon layouts and performance. The prototypes would successfully shoot down a collective 29 target drones during these tests, proving the potential of these aircraft. To the disappointment of enthusiasts, however, the program was shuttered in 1962 as nuclear warfare shifted from bombers to ICBMs, making the prey the plane was meant to hunt all but extinct. The prototypes were put into storage at undisclosed locations as they waited for another buyer to hopefully show interest. That never happened, however, and the aircraft were left forgotten in their hangars, their eventual fate lost to time.

That was until one fortunate day in Trombar. Moe Hill, the owner of a private jet business, purchased a slightly dilapidated hangar on an ex-military base now serving as the local regional airport. The hope was to turn the big hangar into a home for a number of his aircraft, but he could never have imagined what greeted him when he and a group of employees went to examine the hangar. Inside, almost picture perfect, sat prototype #3 of the EXI-71. The plane is in wonderful condition and is currently being transported to the Namara Historic Aviation Society to be restored as much as it can, maybe even to a flyable condition.  (The EXI-71 is a slightly modified version of the IRL XF-108 Rapier)

[b]Grande Montfleur Tries to Integrate Rosenmarkke as December Election Draws Closer[/b]

The nation of Montfleur has recently re-unified with what many call its sibling, Rosenmarkke. Given the vast differences in income, ideology, and general public tradition as well as many more, the merger has proven a little more difficult than some may have expected. King Henri has recently announced that his government is working on establishing a new welfare system, as well as putting out some incentives for companies who wish to do business with the newly proclaimed nation. Grande Montfleurs national elections are also creeping closer, with officials trying to work out how Rosenmarkkes legislative districts will be categorized or even redrawn entirely. The elections arent without new challengers either, as a group of prominent individuals involved in the reunification have formed the Rosenmarkke Salvation Front. This party is somewhat obviously expected to be popular in the south, most likely gaining an unprecedented foothold in government for a newly formed political party. Additionally, while many in the upper class seem to have had ease transitioning to the Montfleuri type of lifestyle, the common person seems to be finding all the commotion and relative busyness of their state replaced by a quietness from the state which many had never experienced before. Unconfirmed polls of the general populace find that nearly 83% of individuals in what used to be Rosenmarkke find the new government they are under confusing and radically different than the one they had before. 

[b]Phoenix IV Satellite Transmits Its First Images of Garuda as it Prepares to Study Titan Moon[/b]

The Lavian AeroSpace Agencys Phoenix IV has recently reached the final leg of its journey to Titan, taking new pictures of Garuda and Aster as it enters Titans orbit. Phoenix IVs mission is to study the potential of a subsurface ocean contained within the moon Aster. The satellite also serves as a technological completion, as it is the largest of any LASA spacecraft used for such a mission. Little is to report on for now, but once it finishes its mission we will know more about Aster than ever before, so make sure to visit the LASAs website to stay updated, as well as keeping up via TSI!

[b]Boat of Tourists Almost Gets Sunk During Military Exercises[/b]

A boat of wealthy Vespurian tourists experienced quite the fright on the 17th. During their deep sea fishing trip, a jet dove down on them and dropped a dummy bomb just over the bow of their vessel. Understandably, this scared them, and they quickly returned to port to figure out why they had been attacked. The tourists had sailed into a restricted Notice To Mariners, or a NTM, which was placed due to military training happening in the area. While the incident did happen recently, the NTSB has had an extraordinarily fast time with this investigation as they have found that the tourist ignored the warning of the owner they rented the boat from, sailed in the opposite direction than they intended to go, and turned off their Automatic Identification System (AIS) because the ship was, as quote, Making an annoying, high pitched alarm noise." The alarm noise which caused them to turn off their AIS was meant to alert the captain that the ship had sailed into the restricted NTM, and that they needed to turn around and exit the area. As seen, they did the opposite to what they were supposed to do, and sailed further into the NTM.

On the other side of this incident, the Navys Carrier Air Training Squadron Six, or CAT-6 Jaguars were testing out their new AS-30T trainer aircraft. Operating off of the ULS Queen Veronica, the jet involved in the incident was apparently taking part in a tradition called Bathtub Bombing, where newly appointed trainers go on online marketplaces searching for the cheapest boats for sale, then getting sailors on ships accompanying the carrier to tow the bathtubs and leave them in a designated area. These trainers would then take off with dummy bombs attached to their aircraft, with the goal of scoring a direct hit on a bathtub and sinking it. The tradition is supposed to be a test of skill as well as a good time on the ship with even civilians watching it via a livestream, however this time it gave some tourists a good scare and a story to tell.

[b]September 4, 2028: A New Capital for a New Nation[/b]

It had long been supposed and planned by those who championed reunification that a new city should become the crown jewel of a unified Rosenmarkket-Montfleurois state, indeed, not only a month after the re-unification, in a meeting with the king, the provisional government for Rosenmarkke pitched the idea before the Grand Assembly, stating that the new city should be located in the former Rosenmarkket capital of Tharkønn, primarily because it already had facilities for a government. 

The matter was a hot-button topic, with many on the right in support of moving to the richer, more powerful region of Mittlemarkke, which was estimated to have 1/4th of the new national GDP flowing from it, whereas Valcur had become dusty, old, and was far poorer than many regions in the nation.

Fearing that the capital idea would never pass the Assembly, the president of the government moved to utilise a rare power to force a snap-vote, which she knew would pass broadly, mainly because for the socialists a move to Tharkønn would represent a linkage with the old socialist order, and for the right, a representation of the new conservative order. 

The vote would pass, with the bishop of Valcur travelling to Tharkønn with the king and president to formally rename the city to Sacré-Cur in honour of both nations' deep Christian heritage. 

The government would outline a 1 ½ year period of time for all offices and government functions to move into the old offices of Rosenmarkke, with plans being drawn up to rebuild the burnt-out husk of the former Rosenmarkket House of the Peoples, which had been a home for the Triumvirate since the 1800s.

[spoiler=Goverment reform and the Shaman issue]
As the year of 2028 went into its second half and economical and infrastructure reconstruction and investment moved along the government of Kuhaw-Astan wrestled with some issues of a more political and sensitive nature; the future structure of the government and how the people on top was elected and the ever present issue of the Shaman minority.

Ever since the joining of all the East-Aboriginal tribes into one nation had become official the now larger tribal senate had been going back and forth in discussion and arguments about what they should and shouldn't do to deal with Shaman issue that were still part of their nation were three main factions had clearly emerged;

The first faction consisted of representatives from mostly the Djuwa, Qawma, Mana and Sui tribes that wanted to give the Shamans equal rights written in law so that they had their rights were the same as any Kuhawan person with out the risk of a future elected government simply rolling over them because the law Didnt say it was illegal", in addition the Shaman minority needed a way to get a direct representative in the government as they had no one at the present time nor did the current system really make it possible to happen.
This also included the right to openly practice the religion of their choice regardless of what that might be.

The second faction was the one that was in some form or shape against this, with arguments such as it being not needed as they were not being actively suppressed, they are already protected by the law as human beings, and why should they get such special and specific treatment?.
This faction mainly consisted of representatives from the tribes of Hukuwy, Lukywa and Tshukwa.

The rest of the tribal representatives mostly fell into the third and last faction that was more a collection of the more neutral representatives that did not lean fully into either of the two other factions with them agreeing and disagreeing to different individual points.
The only point they all could actually agree on however was that the Shaman minority did in fact need direct representation in the tribal senate or it could lead to the growth of resentment and civil unrest in the future.

While there had been lots of discussions and arguing on the issue there was not exactly a lott of progress being made, something that the Djuwa and Qawma representatives was not really thrilled about, thankfully there was at least one point connected to the Shaman issue that had made good progress and that was connected to Shaman representation in the government.

There had emerged a general agreement among the representatives over the 2 years that having the seats in the tribal senate occupied based entirely on the tribes and their sizes was proving to be a mistake that even those that liked power could agree upon.
It had allowed the divides and disagreements of old to stick around almost unchanged and it threatened to turn the nation's politics into the tribal squabbling of old but on an elevated and more internationally visible level, and it most certainly did not help them to create a sense of nationality that could transcend this old tribalism.
It also did not help that it effectively prevented any citizen that was not part of the Kuhaw tribes from joining the tribal senate, which naturaly included the Shaman minority.

It was therefore eventually decided through a majority vote to change the current democratic system of Kuhaw-Astan to a more conventional one with voting zones and political parties similar to those that could be found in some of the other nations of Erene.
While this would not immediately get rid of peoples tribal ties and the old quarrels, and politics tied to them, many hoped that it would allow these ties to erode over time as people got tied to the nation as a whole instead, at least if they could show the people progress and results through its use.
One of the major things that the pro Shaman rights faction managed to get through in the process of dividing the nation into voting zones was the creation of three zones on Astanir that would have majority Shaman voters living in them, these were the port town of Nileen and its surrounding area in the north-eastern most part, the area south of Nileen were the town of  Ruwayd was and the area in the south-east of the country where the town of Zabrah was situated. This would provide the Shaman minority in the Astanir part of Kuhaw-Astan with three zones that they could use to influence the senate so that their voice could be heard.

Some representatives from the second faction naturally tried to hinder the creation of these three zones, as some of them did not feel like the Shamans deserved any influence or power in a nation they saw as rightful Kuhawan land, with the main representative of Hukuwy being their loudest voice among them.
This representative of Hukuwy, named Miro Maayul-balluk, was a young man in his early 20s that sported wavy short black hair that really had the look of a young politician to him, though he was also a man that was suspected to have connections with a Kuhawan extremist group that desired the nation purged of Shaman peoples, and he tried several tactics to impede or alter the creation of the three Shaman zones including starting a short brawl in the senate chamber with a representative from the Sui tribe named Warragul Nuru-Sui.
This brawl did not go as well as he had envisioned however as he ended up having to be saved from the Sui representatives' wrath by the senate guards as the 50 year old man showed him that the military medals on his jacket were more than just mere decorations.
As such the humiliated Miro had to sit through the successful vote to implement the new voting zones while sporting a blue eye and a bloody nose.

With this the month of august became the month where important political and governmental changes were started and the first victory made on the difficult road for Shamat rights, and hopefully not the last.
[/spoiler]
